text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Ah, Ramonu-san! I've been looking for you!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: I have one favor to ask—

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
What do you think of this drawing I made? 
Could you give me some advice, please!?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
I'm competing with my classmates for the 
gold award. Everyone is so serious about 
it... and I refuse to lose either!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: ...I feel no spark whatsoever.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Impressive. You won't be dealt with 
easily.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"...Okay. In that case, I'll just have to 
fire it up! Ramonu-san's heart, that is!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
(Just speaking passionately won't be 
convincing. I need to gather knowledge and 
prove I'm truly serious!)

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: My feelings should reach them with this!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
How does it look? My report on the 
painting, that is!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Just like a textbook. ---How boring.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Oh no! Knowledge alone just isn't enough, 
is it...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Face value alone won't ignite Ramonu's 
passion. In that case, if I can grasp the 
essence of the painting...!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Ummmm... This painting is way too 
abstract. Why is the Umamusume glowing!?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Still, I feel that this light holds true 
meaning. I shall decipher it without 
fail...!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
—That painter saw light in the dynamic 
movements of Umamusume and captured it in 
abstract form! And those are my 
impressions from touring the art 
exhibition!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
I think I'm starting to see the true 
essence of painting just a little bit. 
Could I ask for your advice once more?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Are you... trying to become a critic?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
!! ...Understood. I will start over and 
try again...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Lacks passion," "Textbook," "A critic"— 
What a mess.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
...Still, I suppose that's just where I am 
right now. Only capturing what's outside 
the painting.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Then I'll just keep throwing that part of 
me away until it's gone!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"A retry! I'll hit it with the new and 
improved me!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
…………Huh? I can't draw...! My hand won't 
move!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: It feels so heavy…… and it hurts!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Even so—I can't give up!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
I... made a drawing. Would you look at it 
without saying anything?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Hoh... So that's the look in your eyes 
now. Fine then, just for a little while.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
...Just a single line. Crooked and clumsy, 
isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
I understand now... the profound depth and 
difficulty of painting. And the true 
weight of the brush.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Even so... I still can't give up! That's 
why I brought everything I've got right 
now!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Would you mind if I added a few 
strokes?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Eh, ah, yes!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"A line over my line... Beautiful. Smooth, 
without a trace of hesitation."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Simply as it is.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Just as I am...? Can I really just... be 
myself...?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
I... just need to express myself as my 
heart desires! That's what it means, 
right!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Nnnrgh!! Thank you very much for the 
advice!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, I was helping prepare for the 
Tracen Academy art competition. As artwork 
was continuously brought in—

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Hi! Trainer, have you seen my drawing yet? 
Look, it's the one in the corner.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The picture depicted Daring Heart running 
through raging flames. Just looking at it 
made my heart surge with passion...!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, quite a fine result, wouldn't you 
say?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Naturally! After all, my very soul is 
riding on this!
choice_data_list:
We might actually have a shot at the gold 
prize!?
We can totally win the gold prize!?
I didn't know you were so artistic!

text_block_list.text:
Naturally! After all, my very soul is 
riding on this!
choice_data_list:
We might actually have a shot at the gold 
prize!?
We can totally win the gold prize!?
I didn't know you were so artistic!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
If anything, I'm not even considering 
anything else. Fufu, I can't just sit 
around like this!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Hey! You over there! Once you're done 
getting ready, wanna take a look at my 
painting?! I'd love to hear your thoughts!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps thanks to enthusiastically 
promoting the paintings, she ended up 
taking home the Gold Prize!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
If I had, it wouldn't have been so hard. 
There are tons of girls out there who can 
draw way better than me.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Still, our spirit won't lose out to 
anyone's. We will definitely win the Gold 
Prize!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
True to her word, Daring Heart's drawing 
brilliantly won the gold prize!
